card.name: Abbreviations and codes in citations
card.fires_on: Short abbreviation or code pieces inside references and URLs, such as GS in a bracketed Church-document citation, the p in an aafp.org/afp link, or digits in a DOI.

modes.label: Bracketed document citations
modes.description: Abbreviation for a Church document inside square brackets before a paragraph number.
modes.example: "The Church guards the heritage of God's word and draws from it moral and religious principles without always having at hand the solution to particular problems" [<<GS>>33].)

modes.label: URL and DOI pieces
modes.description: A letter or digit inside a web address or DOI in a reference list.

modes.label: Acronym names
modes.description: Acronym or name part such as RSA or a software name partway through.
modes.example: He is also a founder of<< RSA>> Data Security, now known as RSA Security

card.plain: It lights up on short abbreviations and address pieces inside citations and web links.
